title: RAGFusion: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Cross-Encoder Re-ranking
problem: Open-domain question answering systems struggle when relevant evidence spans multiple documents and requires multi-hop reasoning. Standard RAG pipelines introduce noise by concatenating all retrieved passages without selective integration.
contributions: cross-encoder re-ranker fine-tuned on MS MARCO that improves passage ordering
learned fusion gate that dynamically weights passage contributions
training procedure using distillation from a larger teacher model
comprehensive ablations isolating the contribution of each component
human evaluation study confirming reduced hallucination
limitations: two-stage retrieval pipeline increases latency by approximately 40ms compared to standard RAG
cross-encoder trained on general web data may underperform on highly specialized domains
key_results: outperforms strongest RAG baseline by 4.2 points on NaturalQuestions
outperforms strongest RAG baseline by 6.1 points on HotpotQA
